a_r23_exactness.fails_if: the energy or the reduced gradient on the stored field differs from R23-1's record
a_r23_exactness.reading: the clock generator is NOT zero on the relaxed c = 0 exterior: the R23 point's halo fills the box (R23, the quartic flatness), so the field is biaxial out to the shell and kin is box-dependent there; the two-box read of the plan is the guard

b_clock_generator.fails_if: [G_r, M] differs from the family's own clock flow beyond the O(dt^2) of its central difference
b_clock_generator.reading: on the uniaxial exterior [G_r, S_ext] = 0 exactly (rad, obl and node carry a0 only where their core is anisotropic and not radial; bia and perm in their cores); kin_cert = 0 on an isotropic melted core

c_kin_sign_and_spectral_clock.fails_if: a random block-diagonal field with kin_cert < 0, or a nonzero dS_p along the internal rotation
c_kin_sign_and_spectral_clock.reading: a0 is spatial, so <[a0, A_i], [a0, A_i]>_eta is the Frobenius norm of a spatial block; S_p is invariant under the rotation, so the spectral term is blind to the clock: it enters E_stat only

d_discriminant.deviation: the plan's evaluation route (the sympy polynomial in S_1..S_4) is kept as this identity control only: at g = 8 its monomials (up to S_1^12) cancel to zero on the degenerate vacuum with 1e-6 absolute noise and the reduced gradient failed the FD gate at 1e-2; the run evaluates the same function from the eigenvalues (lambda_0 = -M_00 and the symmetric 3 x 3 block), gradient assembled without division, exact at a coalescing pair
d_discriminant.fails_if: the two routes disagree at g 1.5, Disc or its gradient nonzero on the degenerate vacuum or the uniaxial seed, K_D off its closed form

e_fd_gate.fails_if: the reduced gradient disagrees with the Richardson pair of central differences beyond 1e-5 relative

f_two_selective_members_on_R23.reading: a record of how the two members differ on this field, never a gate (prior claim (i))

g_lifts.fails_if: a lift or its gradient nonzero on the degenerate vacuum or the uniaxial exterior, the pair-splitting cost off eps beta^2, or the FD gate beyond 1e-5

center.J_1_definition: J_1 = 2 kin_rad(J = 0) omega_G, omega_G^2 = 3 (2/h sin(pi h / 2 L_free))^2 on the n 24 box; the same J values on every box and point (the charge is the invariant)

closure_at_J_1_rad.fails_if: the envelope slope differs from omega* by more than 3 percent (R4's G6 gate)

cost.note: a sweep point warm-starts its J = 0 relaxations from the center's states, so its cost is bounded by this table

ranges.rule: each new term at its range end equals the certified static energy (quartic + V4) of the relaxed bia state at J = 0; c6 ranges over [-c6_max, c6_max], lam_s and lam_sel over [0, max]; the FD gate (controls (e)) was run at weights inside these ranges
